mechanism_claims.claim_text: HBP peptides, especially HBP-4/HBP-5 and HBP-5 derivatives, directly bind LPS in the BODIPY-cadaverine displacement assay; EC50 values are recorded in Tables 3/4 and Appendix Table S4/source data.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HBP-1 to HBP-5, CPC mutants, HBP-5 [1-20], and dHBP-5 where tabulated
mechanism_claims.limitations: LPS affinity supports target engagement; it is not by itself proof of a single lethal pathway.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper links antimicrobial activity to bacterial envelope effects using membrane depolarization, outer-membrane/permeability assays, killing curves, and SEM imaging in E. coli contexts.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HBP-1 to HBP-5 with strongest emphasis on HBP-4/HBP-5

mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is reported as envelope disruption/permeabilization context; avoid reducing it to a single molecular target beyond LPS binding plus membrane damage assays.
